notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/23/2025)
notes.content:
More updates! Today's update addresses more crashes and a nasty softlock.

Thank you once more for your dedication to our demo! Remember to head to the Community Discord Server to mingle with those who've played and report bugs more directly!


Full Patch Notes (09/23/2025):


Bugfixes:

Fixed several crashes surrounding the French Cuisine moveset

Fixed an issue where Shield Moves would crash the game if a certain Passive was equipped

Cook! keyword now fails if BLANK has no more inventory space

Potluck! keyword can now no longer damage BLANK

Fixed a crash associated with swapping moves

Fixed a softlock that would brick a run in CA map "Floor 3?", associated with Simply You's introduction cutscene



Other changes:

Streamline Shopkeeper dialogue slightly

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/22/2025)
notes.content:
Another day, another update! We're beginning to catch up. 

This one is intended to address the major softlocks found in the Field of Forget-Me-Nots "Down the Drain" map, and the maze-like map in the Complex Apartments. If these two maps should still easily softlock your game, please do let us know!



Thank you for continuing to play the Blanksword demo and your immense support!


Full Patch Notes (09/22/2025):


Bugfixes:

Fix a function associated with 38 Move Evolutions that used the wrong sign to calculate damage output

Hopefully fix a softlock in FOFMN map "Down the Drain", where no keys would spawn

Hopefully fix a softlock in CA map "Turn another corner; there you are" where no exit and/or no gift-room would spawn

Fix Hide status effect adding a ridiculous amount of extra-Shield

Completely overhaul "Quit to Title" functionality, hopefully squashing several save-corrupting issues in the process

Fix OOB in FOFMN map "A House on Fire"

Fix Tenderness Evos

Fix Shield Bash evolution "Shield Crash"... crashing the game

Remove two respawn points in Single Room map "The Park" that could be used to circumvent an important choke-point

Make it impossible for moves to evolve more than once



Other changes:

Make Your Happy Home-Owner hopefully say something utterly wretched when attacked in his sleep

Allow Players to rematch the Mold Beast! Perhaps even more than once per run, if you're lucky...!

Improve timing on secret ending-cutscene

Add short name to Philosophical Edge

Fix several typos

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/21/2025)
notes.content:
Once more, here's an update to the demo build!

This one is very important, as it resolves several crashes, and a game-breaking bug.

We're extremely grateful for the outpouring of love from all of you who've played the demo so far, and hope to continue to make it a smoother experience!


Full Patch Notes (09/21/2025):


Bugfixes:

Fixed crashes associated with _move_inv_length

Fixed crashes associated with unit_move_queue

Fix a persistent crash that would break the save file of anyone unlucky enough to backtrack through a certain Finite Forest map. (If you are affected by this: Reloading your save now will make it work again!)

Fixed crashes that occur when multiple reward types are present at the end of battle

Fixed crashes associated with o_HITBOX and sword-slashing

Fix Pep Talk and Hurful Words evos

Attempt to fix an issue with the dialogue-system's positioning that would embed the player in a wall

Fix wrong-warp in the Complex Apartments' second floor

Fix several more move evolutions' level thresholds



Other changes:

Gave the three-dog party in the Dog Arena map a red "elite encounter" outline

Fixed various typos

Improve conveyance on Sensitive Foliage's store description

Fill in some missing Angel of the Mind Notes

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (09/19/2025)
notes.content:
Further bugfixes since yesterday! There are many to work through, so please excuse if a bug you've found hasn't quite been addressed yet.

If you should find any crashes or bugs, feel free let us know in our Discord!


Full patch notes (09/19/2025):


Bugfixes

Fix an issue where having the Sensitive Foliage equipped would crash the game on toggling Key Items.

Fix a crash related to Remember-Me and Existential Crisis

Fix a crash associated with the stat-menu

Fix Venomskin's evolutions

Make Waterbug Arts able to evolve again

Fix several Gossip-error rainbow-text bugs

Remove unfinished move "Snail Arts"

Fix application of "On-Kill" keyword effects for several move evolutions

Fix volume and frequency of certain blipspeak sounds



Other changes

Fix various typos in move descriptions

Improve conveyance on Brain Part menu

Remove Wile E. Coyote-style joke at the player's expense in Broken Bridge map, related to collecting EXP in mid-air. It was fun while it existed!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
It's time for our Demo's first update! Today and yesterday's patches address some gnarly collision bugs - we've also fixed some unintended behaviors and added some quality of life improvements. 

If you run into any bug or issue during your travels inside His Country, you can hop into our Discord and let us know :] 


Full patch notes (09/18/2025):


Bugfixes

Attempt a fix at an issue where collision from either hazards or walls would carry over from one map to the next and cause crashes and softlocks

Fix an issue where slashing a Chest and an enemy simultaneously would break battle display

Fix unavailable move descriptions for several move evolutions that would crash the game

Fix Shadow Clones animating while the menu is open

Fix missing keyword tooltip on "Gourmet Slash"

Fix Gates not resetting properly on-death

Fix Talksounds not being beholden to Master Volume

Fix several typos



Other changes

Added key-item equivalents to all brain parts so players can keep track of which parts they do and do not have

Add a missing credit to the Credits
